verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase is a built-in natural-language chat assistant in the Firebase console. It answers questions, generates code, and generates schemas, queries and mutations on demand. It also analyzes Crashlytics crashes with root-cause and fix suggestions, and summarizes messaging campaigns. The documented role is mostly advisory and generative; there is no evidence it autonomously carries out actions on the user's project. The MCP server is used through external clients, so it is not a built-in assistant and is not credited. missing for 10: evidence the in-console assistant executes delegated tasks directly in the project (agentic actions), independent or hands-on corroboration of its effectiveness
